entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This spot on the floor... It looks kind of[n]like a mouse...

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This spot on the floor... It looks like[n]someone's face...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's smiling...? Or maybe it's angry? I can't[n]tell... It keeps changing as I look at it.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This spot on the floor... It looks kind[n]of like an island.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And there's a hole there, where treasure[n]is buried. Heh... That sounds like an[n]exciting adventure.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This spot on the floor... It looks kind of[n]like you.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Look at the way it spreads out...[n]It looks exactly like your messy hair.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You know, this spot on the floor...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Why does it seem to look different[n]every time we come here...?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, stop ignoring me.

entries.speaker: Morgana

Say...
Did I close the window[n]in my room...?
My back itches...
I'm getting sleepy...
My foot's fallen asleep...
I wonder if I crossed[n]my legs correctly...
I wonder what Morgana[n]was saying earlier...
It's quiet...
It's quiet, but...
My head feels[n]strangely heavy...
My head feels heavy again...
My mind and body feel so light...

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Ahh, what a great view, a splendid view[n]even!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, you don't get to complain, got it?[n]You gotta overcome this and break the[n]limits of your concentration!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Whew, that was surprisingly relaxing.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hey, don't get mad now. Your mind's[n]gotta be at peace and all that. Riiight?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Wow, you're amazing...

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Geez, you freaked me out...! You couldn't[n]have been floating. There's no way...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Man, you really are something.
I'm still getting distracted[n]by idle thoughts...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: The expression on your face changed a[n]bit though. Is your mind a bit more[n]composed now?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hm... That expression on your face isn't so[n]bad. Is your mind more composed now?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: All joking aside, you've really changed.[n]Looks like your mind has gotten more[n]composed.

entries.speaker: Morgana

entries.speaker: Morgana
